Temple Sinai Bat Mitzvah DJ
Bat-Mitzvah Party for Bat-Mitzvah Party, April 26th 2014

Location Oakland California.

Games:
– cha cha slide
– Cupid shuffle
– marshmallow run
– musical chairs

Group participation:
– Macarena
– Electric Slide
– Cupid shuffle
– cha cha slide

Things I want to do:
– candle lighting
– the chair hora
– last dance
